description_expanded: Top Reasons to Book this Beautiful Home* Located within a mile of Inlet Beach Regional Beach Access* 350ft stroll to the Grande Pointe dock on Lake Powell. Great for fishing or kayaking!* 4 Bikes Included!* Community pool - Seasonally Heated* Network of nature trails around Lake Powell* Short distance to some of the best restaurants in 30A! - Cuvee 30A, amici 30A, Aja 30A, and Canopy Road Café, and Shaka Sushi.* Snorkel the Grouper Reef-more info under Area Attractions below* Located in beautiful Inlet Beach* Professionally Managed; 24/7 ServiceWelcome to Grand Pointe Sea Shell, a charming and cozy 3-bedroom, 2.5-bath beach retreat located in the breathtaking Inlet Beach. The airy and open floor plan invites quality time with your loved ones, while the spacious living and dining areas provide ample room for relaxation and entertainment. The kitchen is beautifully appointed with granite countertops, stainless steel appliances, and a wide array of cooking utensils and small appliances, making it a dream for culinary enthusiasts. Upstairs, you'll discover sleeping arrangements for up to 8 guests. The master bedroom boasts a king-size bed, a Roku smart TV with cable, and a sprawling covered balcony where you can unwind and soak up the coastal vibes. The en-suite bathroom features a luxurious walk-in shower, adding a touch of indulgence to your stay. The guest bedroom offers a comfortable queen-size bed and a smart TV with cable, while the third guest bedroom features 2 full beds and a smart TV with cable. This inviting home comfortably accommodates up to 8 guests, ensuring everyone has a restful and enjoyable stay. Whether you're seeking relaxation or excitement, Grand Pointe Sea Shell has it all. Take a refreshing dip in the community pool, try your hand at fishing from the community dock on picturesque Lake Powell, or simply bask in the golden sun at stunning Inlet Beach. Whatever your preference, Grand Pointe Sea Shell is the ideal destination for an unforgettable vacation.*This property is NOT AVAILABLE for rent to those under the age of 25. No Exceptions.* *We LOVE Snowbirds! Low Monthly Winter Rates*Snowbird Season runs January thru February, on a monthly basis. To prepare a qualified quote, select your arrival date (must be the 1st day of the month) and the departure date (must be the 1st day of the month). Alternate dates must be pre-approved. All monthly rentals are subject to an additional $150 cleaning fee. Please contact us with your interest and to further assist!Grande Pointe at Inlet Beach offers an exclusive coastal community of upscale homes bordering Camp Helen State Park and overlooking Lake Powell. Spanning over 30 acres, the beautiful homes in Grande Pointe have been integrated into the natural environment, keeping much of the native foliage and large trees. The result is a charming and private waterfront village in a lush, natural setting. A lakefront pavilion makes the perfect meeting place for special events and accessing nature paths leading to Lake Powell, the community dock and swimming pool.Bed Setup:2nd Floor:Mater Bedroom: King BedGuest Bedroom: Queen BedGuest Bedroom: 2 Full BedsArea Attractions:Serving as the gateway to 30A, 30Avenue is located at the intersection of Highway 98 and east entry of famed Scenic Highway 30A. It is a lifestyle center offering exceptional restaurants, boutique shopping, health and beauty services all within easy walking distance of Inlet, Rosemary, Seacrest and Alys beaches.Services include a med spa, yoga, beauty lounge and more! Boutique shopping and loads of delicious food including:Aja elevated Asian Kitchen - Master Chef Tom Catherall has created a menu showcasing elevated Asian cuisines. The menu includes a variety of authentic dishes such as sushi, sashimi, stir-fries, and noodle dishes. Amici Italian Kitchen offering authentic Italian cuisine with a flair for celebration and uses only the best ingredients to prepare fresh and handmade dishes cooked to order in a lively exhibition kitchen.Amigos authentic Mexican cuisine with a flair for celebration. amigo’s 30A Mexican Kitchen brings delicious Mexican food to 30A in a welcoming, family-style atmosphere.Canopy Road Cafe specializes in traditional breakfast and lunch fare, with some fresh, funky and innovative twists.Cuvee30A - Savor celebrity Chef Tim Creehan’s award winning signature dishes such as Amy Grant’s Seared Tuna Rare and Vince Gill’s Pecan Crusted Grouper in a stunning venue at the junction of 30A and Highway 98. The DiRoNA awarded restaurant also features their “Best of the Emerald Coast” voted Happy Hour and a world class Wine List awarded the 30A area’s only Wine Spectator Best of Award of Excellence 2016-2022. Goatfeathers at 30Avenue is your local favorite seafood restaurant, fish market and specialty store. Southern Charm Coffee & Gather with the sweet and rich aromas from our Fresh Baked Desserts and Our custom Roast In- House Decadent Dessert Blend Coffee.Powell Lake straddles Walton County and Bay County and borders much of Camp Helen State Park on the gulf side and the development of Wild Heron on the north side. It is the largest of the coastal dune lakes in Walton County and allows motorboats and jet skis. Access the lake at Camp Helen State Park, county park at N. Walton Lakeshore Drive, or the Lake Powell boat ramp in Bay County. Approx 650 acres.Enjoy the beautiful sugar white sand beaches that made 30A world famous. Enjoy walking and biking everywhere around Rosemary, Seacrest, and Alys Beach. Don't miss the newly opened 30Avenue for even more dining and shopping options. 30Avenue is just north of Rosemary across Hwy 98, near both Shades Sports Bar and The Donut Hole. This laid back, fun family atmosphere awaits you! Come stay and play and see for yourself what makes our community and the 30A area so special! Read less
